title: Leo Learns to Roar
subtitle: A Color & Read Story Book for Kids Ages 3-6
author: Your Pen Name

pages.text: Leo is a little lion. He lives in a big, sunny jungle.
Leo wants to ROAR like his dad. But he can only squeak!
Leo meets Ella the elephant. "Try again!" she says.
Leo meets Tiko the monkey high up in a tree.
Pip the bird sings, "Take a BIG breath!"
Leo takes a big breath... and ROARS!
All his friends cheer. Hooray for Leo!
Goodnight, Leo. Sweet dreams under the stars.

cover.blurb:
Leo is a little lion with a big dream: he wants to ROAR!

Color Leo and his jungle friends as you read along. Big, easy words make it perfect for early readers, and thick, simple lines are made for little hands.

- Short story with BIG letters
- 8 fun pages to color
- One-sided pages so markers don't bleed through
